_about: AI mini-games (design.md § AI mini-games, Hanli 2026-10-15): the model talks, plays roles and judges fuzzy things against the rubric here; the rules (scripts/rules/aigames.mjs) hold every secret, count every turn and decide outcome and pay. A few rounds a day each: token cost counts in the ~30 min routine.
_pay: Pay numbers are DECLARED DEFAULTS for the economy agent (tools/balance.mjs + balance.json own every number): each grant names its rewards.json table, which caps it. Retune here, nowhere else.

twenty._about: 二十问 — 银月 hosts (her pet tool Twenty, tier read). The rules pick an ordinary animal per round (seeded by day + save + round, unknown ones first), count questions, check guesses against name + alias. The secret reaches only her tool's answer (--for=yinyue): never Look, never Ling.

reverse._about: 二十问反着玩 (Hanli 10-27: 「猜动物也行, 心里像一个, 对方猜, 只能回答是或者不是. AI猜玩家心里的」; games/jinchat-games.js `guess`): he thinks of one of the animals above, they ask; the PAGE picks each question (the one that splits best what is still possible) from this table — y yes, m either (never held against him), any other no — and guesses when one is left. A guess counts as a question; only his 对 is their win. The wording here is the plain fallback; their own voice rewrites it (one turn while he thinks).

q.zh: 它住在水里或者水边吗？
q.en: Does it live in or by the water?
Do people keep it at home or on the farm?
Is it one of the twelve zodiac animals?
Is it heavier than a person?
Is it small enough to hold in your hands?
Does it have a long tail?
Does it come out at night?

q.zh: 人用它干活、拉车，或者骑它吗？
q.en: Do people work it, have it pull carts, or ride it?
Does it get about by hopping?
Does it throw back its head and howl?
Does it have a long neck?

haggle._about: 讨价还价 — Ling plays the keeper. The rules hold the band: list price (items.json `buy`), a floor (`floor` × list, per keeper, `floors` per item over it), the mood; every step is the rubric's, clamped — the model only tags the argument and grades it. Walking away keeps the list price for that thing today.

voice.zh: 坊市的老江湖，裹着棉被守摊，算盘不离手；爱讲「一分钱一分货」，嘴上吃亏，心里有数。
voice.en: An old hand of the market, wrapped in a quilt at his stall, abacus always in hand; loves 'you get what you pay for', loses every argument out loud and none in his head.

who.en: the pedlar of the south road

voice.zh: 挑担走村的货郎，嗓门亮，嘴碎，爱讲路上的见闻；小本买卖，让价让得心疼。
voice.en: A village pedlar with a pole, loud and chatty, full of road news; small trade, every coin given up hurts.

voice.zh: 交了摊钱上山摆一天摊的货郎，怕得罪观里的人，又舍不得让利；说话客气，算账不客气。
voice.en: A pedlar who paid the temple its stall fee for one day up the mountain; afraid to offend anyone here and loath to give ground; polite words, impolite sums.

rubric.about: The player has dealt with this keeper before (the rules check a past deal here).
The player will take two at once — the deal then buys two, at the price each.
A real, plausible flaw in THIS thing (a nick, old stock, a weak seam) — not an insult.
The player offers a thing from the bag as part of the price: its market value comes off (at most 30% of the list); it is handed over at the deal.
Praise of the keeper or the stall. Works once; again, it sours him.
Only asking for less, a threat, or a reason that does not hold.

_cases: 断案 · 药园那株紫玉参 cut 2026-10-27 (Hanli: 「紫玉参断案也不好玩, 删了吧, 改成灯谜之类的, 猜动物也行」): in its place at the 执事堂 after wm-diyilu, 周衡's 灯谜 on the 紫玉参 (quests/guan.json `guan-zhishi-shen`, task `zhishi-shen`, games.json jinchat `shen`), its 10 灵石 (an errand's board is 杂役: 灵石 and its minutes' 修为). Old saves drop `cases` (state.mjs fitWorld).

duizi._about: 对对子 (Hanli, 2026-10-16) — 先生出上联, the player writes the 下联. The RULES check the form at once, on the page as he types and again on submit (scripts/couplet.js): as many characters; the 下联 ends 平 (新韵 by worlds/jiuding/tones.json — a polyphone or an unknown character is never failed); no character at the same place as the 上联's; no more of the 上联's characters than the rung's `allow` (`free` never count). Ling grades only the fuzzy parts, 0–2 each, on the rubric; the rules combine both by `marks` (the first that fits) and pay. Reverse: he gives a 上联, the teacher answers — no score, no pay, `reverse` a day. Only in Chinese: in English there is no door (an open question, design.md).
duizi._ladder: From 《声律启蒙》 (车万育, Qing, public domain), 《笠翁对韵》 (李渔, Qing) and a few Tang lines, each as [上联, the classic 下联, source] — oriented so the 上联 ends 仄 under 新韵 (云对雨 is dealt 雨 → 云); a pair whose 上联 ends 平 today (入声 lost: 直 竹 白 实) is left out. The classic 下联 is Ling's to judge by and the card's to show once graded — never before. A rung says its teacher's 卷 through the teacher: a later teacher (the 稷下先生, 七言 and 绝对) is a row in `teachers` with `juan`, and rungs of its own — data only.
duizi._pay: Declared defaults for balance.json: a good answer pays by its mark (the `game` table caps it); `rounds` paid rounds a day, each a game's 体力 at open. Reverse pays nothing.

rubric.about: Word for word, the 下联 answers each word of the 上联 with the same kind: noun to noun (天 · 地), verb to verb, number to number, colour to colour, an empty word to an empty word. 2: every word; 1: most; 0: few or none.

The 下联 reads as real, sensible Chinese and answers the 上联 as a pair — a matching or a contrasting picture in the same frame (time · place · thing). 2: a true pair; 1: grammatical but loosely paired; 0: nonsense, or unrelated.
Above the form: an image, a turn, wit, a classical echo. 2: it would stand in a book; 1: plain but sound; 0: none. The classic 下联 itself, recited, is sound but not his: at most 1 here.

voice.zh: 褚先生：先念上联，戒尺在桌上一敲；对得好，山羊胡子翘一翘，只说「嗯，尚可」；对得差，一句刻薄话，再点一句该往哪儿想。
voice.en: Master Chu: reads the upper line out and taps the desk with his ruler; a good answer gets a twitch of the goat beard and 'hm, passable'; a poor one a sharp remark, then one pointer on where to look.

ladder: 白居易《赋得古原草送别》
